about-our-community.title: About Our Community — School Of Unified Healing

headings.text: Community is at the heart of everything we do.

We believe that true healing happens when we come together, support one another, and grow as a collective. Our community is a place where you can connect with like-minded souls, share your journey, and find the support you need to thrive—spiritually, mindfully, emotionally, and physically.

Our mission is to provide the space, resources, and practices that facilitate personal growth and healing. With over 30 teachers volunteering their time for free we are able to fulfill our mission of bringing healing to everyone.

We address the rising demand of accessible and consistent holistic health support regardless of financial or economic status. By offering a platform based on the principles of devotional service we overcome the barriers of money and foster a new culture based on unconditional giving and receiving.
Our goal is to educate individuals on the nature of healing and how integrating the dimensions of the self lead us to live fulfilling and healthy lives.
Our aim is to develop all our schools to become self-sustainable, allowing the cafe, shop and resource revenue to be the main generation of sustainable income.

All profit is reinvested back into the growth of our organisation, and social programs. Community donations contribute significantly to the initial start up costs of new schools, without this support our work would not be possible.

Empowering our community to inquire into the potential of their self and ignite their connection to their true nature creates the radical shift necessary to raising the consciousness of ourselves, each other and our planet.
We offer 30 free classes each week, making healing accessible to all.
Create a safe, sacred space for individuals to reconnect with themselves and find peace.
Host deep immersion classes and workshops that help people awaken their inner power, heal past wounds, and discover new paths forward.
Establish a platform for our facilitators and volunteers to share from a place of devotional service, fostering the personal benefits of unconditional giving within community.
Build a supportive, empowering environment where everyone is welcomed and encouraged to grow.
Our community is more than just a gathering of individuals. It's a living, breathing network of souls on a journey toward healing and transformation.
Support: Our community is filled with people ready to uplift, inspire, and support you on you spiritual journey.
Connection: You'll meet like-minded individuals who share your passion for growth, healing, and transformation.
Opportunities for Growth: Participate in our free classes, deep immersion workshops, and transformative events designed to help you find balance and peace.
A Safe Space: We create a judgment-free, heart-centered environment where you can fully be yourself.
Learn More About Teaching With Us
When the Heart of Our Community Speaks
We are founded upon nonprofit spiritual values driven by the belief that true healing comes from giving and receiving with an open heart.

Description A steady, intentional Hatha practice that weaves together asana, pranayama, meditation, and embodied awareness. Moving at an easy-to-follow pace, this class includes intentional moments of pause between postures, offering space to notice, soften, and connect more deeply with the breath and with yourself. With a strong focus on alignment and breath, students are invited to build strength, cultivate balance, and move with greater presence throughout the practice. Suitable for all levels, this class is especially supportive for beginners or anyone looking for a more grounded and accessible approach to yoga. Benefits: - Improves strength and balance through steady, alignment-focused practice - Supports nervous system regulation through breath awareness and moments of pause - cultivate presence, inner calm, and a deeper connection to self Who should avoid the class This class is accessible to most students, including beginners. It should only be avoided by those who have been advised by a medical professional that gentle movement is not suitable for them. Students who are pregnant, recovering from surgery, or managing specific health concerns are encouraged to let the teacher know before class so appropriate modifications can be offered.

Description The class is a group practice from the Babaji lineage that uses the transformational power of om to activate the self-healing potential of participants. Bathing in its resonance clears mental and physical blockages, promotes inner peace, mental clarity, emotional freedom and physical health as the chanting generates a vibrational frequency that releases negativity, transforms it and showers participants with positive energy. The vibrational waves created by the OM Chanting practice continue to resonate in participants bodies after the circle allowing them to share the good vibrations wherever they go. Benefits: - Nervous System Regulation: The vibration of OM lengthens exhalation, activates the vagus nerve, and settles the sympathetic “fight–flight” response. This brings calm, reduces anxiety, and stabilizes emotional reactivity. - Energetic Alignment: OM resonates through the whole body, especially crown, throat, and heart, creating coherence between subtle energy centers. Many traditions hold it as the primordial sound, so chanting it re-tunes your field to that baseline frequency. - Expanded Awareness: The sound naturally draws attention inward, quiets the mental field, and anchors awareness in presence. Over time, this dissolves identification with thought and allows direct experience of unity or inner spaciousness. Who should avoid this class: People with acute psychosis, schizophrenia, or severe dissociation should avoid regular chanting. They may find the sound resonance destabilizing, as it can amplify inner voices or intensify altered states

Description The only safe place is your true self. Sometimes in life, we feel lost, unrooted, alone, or even homeless within ourselves. We may search for balance in the outside world, but the journey is not about becoming someone else. It is about finding our way back home — to who we truly are. In Ayurveda, the five elements (Pancha Mahabhutas) offer a framework for understanding the qualities of nature within our body and mind. Through asanas (yoga postures), pranayama (breathwork), mudras (hand gestures), and a little Brazilian music, we will explore and connect with the five elements — Space, Air, Fire, Water, and Earth — within our body, mind, and spirit. Benefits: This practice invites greater self-awareness, openness to intuition, deep relaxation, and a connection with the qualities of each element. Space: Expansion, connection with the sacred, and a sense of openness. Air: Creativity, freedom, lightness, and movement. Fire: Personal power, courage, confidence, and transformation. Water: Flexibility, adaptability, and the ability to feel and express emotions. Earth: Grounding, relaxation, calmness, stability, confidence, and improved sleep. Who should avoid: This practice is accessible to most people, including beginners. However, it may not be suitable for everyone. It is not recommended for pregnant women, people recovering from surgery, individuals experiencing acute psychiatric episodes, or those taking antipsychotic medication. If you have another health concerns please let the teacher know.

Description A guided journey into identity and alignment. Through guided self-inquiry, structured reflection, and a short future-vision exercise, you will reconnect with your inner direction and explore what alignment truly means beyond societal expectations. This is not about quick answers. It is about remembering who you are — and what feels true. Benefits: - Gain clarity on what currently feels misaligned in your life or work - Reconnect with your natural strengths and inner compass - Experience a guided future-self visualization to explore your deeper direction Who Should Avoid This Class: - This class is not a physical yoga practice, nor a purely theoretical lecture. - It is not about quick motivation. -It is designed for those who are open to honest self-reflection and inner exploration.

Description This class is an invitation to slow down, open your heart and reconnect with the deeper layers of yourself and others. Through conscious connection, presence, shamanic drum and song, you will be gently guided from the outer world into your inner landscape, a space where intuition, inner vision and the wisdom of the heart can unfold. We begin by meeting each other in presence, before turning inward and allowing the rhythm of the drum to carry you on an inner journey. There is nothing you need to achieve or understand. Simply allow yourself to feel, listen, receive and be. As you soften and open, you may experience a deeper connection with your own heart, your intuition and the subtle world beyond the thinking mind. You may encounter images, sensations, emotions or insights, or simply rest in a profound sense of stillness and presence. This is an invitation to step beyond the familiar, to listen to what lives beneath the surface and to explore the space where body, heart, intuition and spirit meet. Benefits: - Strengthens your intuition by creating space to listen to your inner knowing and explore your inner vision. - Enhanses the feeling of compassion, connection and a deeper sense of love to yourself and others. - Opens up for healing, deep relaxation and presence Who should avoid this class: Not recommended for people living with epilepsy, experiencing an acute psychiatric episode, or taking antipsychotic medication, unless approved by a healthcare provider.

Description This class is an invitation to reconnect with yourself through your body, your breath and your inner rhythm. We begin with mindful breathing (pranayama), meditation and yoga asanas, gradually awakening body awareness and exploring the connection between the physical and subtle dimensions of our being. Through a gentle and conscious body preparation, we allow the practice to naturally unfold into fluid, intuitive movement. From grounded yoga to more expressive and spontaneous ways of moving, you are invited to listen to your body, follow its impulses and discover the freedom of movement. Some sessions may gradually open into a guided free-movement or ecstatic dance experience, accompanied by music, creating space for deeper expression and connection. This is an opportunity to release tension, cultivate presence, explore your own expression and reconnect with the joy of being fully alive in your body. Each session is a unique journey into movement, awareness and inner freedom, inviting you to explore, feel and simply be. Benefits: - Deepen Body Awareness & Presence: Develop a deeper connection with your body and breath, cultivate mindfulness and feel more present in the moment. - Release Tension & Restore Inner Balance: Release physical and emotional tension through conscious breathing, yoga and fluid movement, inviting greater ease and balance. - Embrace Self-Expression & Inner Freedom: Explore intuitive movement, reconnect with your natural rhythm and open up to a deeper sense of joy, freedom and authentic expression. Who Should Avoid This Class: This practice may not be suitable for individuals with acute injuries, significant physical limitations, or medical conditions that could be aggravated by yoga, breathwork or free movement. Those with cardiovascular conditions, uncontrolled high blood pressure, or who are pregnant should consult their healthcare provider before participating. Please always listen to your body, respect your limits and move at your own pace.

Benefits: - Discover what true love really is — Understand the difference between romantic or emotional love and the deeper recognition of love that already exists within us. - Understand the foundations of a conscious relationship — Explore recognition, self-love, honoring who you are, and allowing another person the freedom to be themselves. - See relationships as a mirror — Discover what your expectations, reactions, and struggles reveal about you, and how this understanding can transform the way you love. Who Should Avoid This Class: Not recommended for individuals currently experiencing acute psychiatric episodes or those on antipsychotic medications, unless advised by a healthcare provider.

Description What if some of the limiting behaviour patterns, blocks, struggles and burdens you experience in your current life are not really about what is happening right now? What if some of these limitations are rooted in memories and experiences from the past that your system still responds to as if they are relevant to your survival today? And what if these old patterns can be reconditioned by bringing them into the present moment, where the old "truths" can meet the reality of who you are now? Family Constellations offers a way to explore the deeper layers behind our emotions, reactions, and recurring patterns. It can help us understand how challenges in our present lives may be connected to dynamics, beliefs, and conditioning from our family of origin, including responsibilities or burdens that may not truly belong to us. By bringing these unconscious patterns into awareness through observation and experience, we can begin to recognize what is no longer relevant to our lives today and explore healthier ways of responding. Rather than only understanding patterns intellectually, the process allows us to experience them through the body, creating space for greater awareness, self-regulation, and personal change. Each Sunday, the class takes a different approach. We may work in pairs or small groups, or explore one participant’s question through a full-group constellation. Through observing and participating, you can discover the deeper relevance of Family Constellations as a practice for healing, personal growth, and self-exploration. Benefits: - More confidence, self-love and acceptance of situations - Greater emotional independence and healthier relationships - More focus, empowerment and freedom to create the life you want Who should avoid this class: The classes are open to everybody, but you are always asked to take responsibility for yourself. Through a carefully guided breathwork experience, participants are invited to explore emotions, release tension and awaken their vital energy. Benefits: - Emotional Release & Inner Freedom: Create space to explore emotions, release accumulated tension and experience a greater sense of inner lightness. - Vitality, Energy & Joy: Awaken your life force through the combination of conscious breathing, music and spontaneous movement. - Deep Connection & Embodiment: Reconnect with your body, cultivate presence and experience authentic self-expression in a supportive environment. What to Expect: A carefully facilitated 150-minute journey: - 10 min | Landing & Grounding: Arrival, gentle grounding and connection with the present moment. - 15 min | Opening Circle: Introductions, intentions, agreements and preparation for the journey. - 45 min | Conscious Connected Breathwork: A guided breathing experience accompanied by an immersive musical journey. - 50 min | Ecstatic Dance: A seamless transition from breath into free, intuitive movement, supported by a progressive musical journey. - 15 min | Integration Circle: Grounding, reflection and space to integrate the experience. - 10 min | Closing Circle: Gratitude, sharing and collective closure. - 5 min | Aftercare Guidelines: Practical recommendations for hydration, rest, grounding and emotional integration. Participation is voluntary, and everyone is encouraged to respect their personal physical and emotional boundaries. About the Facilitator: Dave Pastanella, known as The Joy Awakener, is a transformative coach, mentor, breathwork and embodiment facilitator, ecstatic dance DJ and music producer. His path began through a profound personal transformation. Details & Booking Date : Friday, December 4th Time : 14:00pm - 16:30pm Cost : 280K BOOK HERE Dvara is Sanskrit for "door" or "gateway." This workshop invites you to step through one. DVARA is a restorative experience that combines Empowerment Yin yoga with breathwork, journalling and guided visualisation. Long, supported postures let the body soften and release. Reflective prompts and meditation open space for introspection. Together they help you tune into the subtle energies of your body and heart, and deepen your awareness of yourself. The aim is more connection, compassion and fulfilment in your life. This is a chance to pause and reflect on where you are, notice what you're ready to leave behind, and step towards what's waiting on the other side. Benefits: - Deepen your connection to your body. Slow, supported holds draw you out of the mind and into the body. You can feel your breath, your sensations and the subtle signals beneath the surface. - Embody your truth. Movement, breath, meditation and journaling create space to listen inward, express what's there, and trust what you already know. What to Expect: A 2-hour immersive practice: - 75 minutes of restorative Empowerment Yin. We'll move slowly through a series of long-held, supported postures. Self-discovery prompts woven through the sequence will gently guide you towards what's ready to shift. - Future self meditation. A guided visualisation to connect with the version of you that's emerging, and to listen to what your body and inner awareness are communicating. - Closing circle. Time to share and integrate whatever has arisen. This is a permissive workshop, which means your own expression is welcome. You might journal, move, or speak aloud if it feels right. There's no right way to do this practice. Please bring a journal and a willingness to venture inward. Who should avoid this workshop: This practice is gentle, but long holds and inner work can bring a lot to the surface. Please speak with our team before booking if you: - Are pregnant or have recently given birth - Have a recent injury, surgery or acute pain - Are going through a mental health crisis, or are in the early stages of processing trauma All postures can be modified with props. You're always free to come out of a pose, rest, or step back from sharing. About the Facilitator: Marnie’s curiosity led her across the world and, more importantly, inward. To a deeper truth that continues to shape both her approach to life and her teaching. With a background in brand storytelling, entrepreneurship and the arts, Marnie brings a uniquely creative essence to her teaching. Marnie has completed over 500 hours of training in Power Yoga, Meditation and Pranayama, Empowerment Yoga, and Hands-on Adjustments. She now calls Bali home, but teaches workshops worldwide.
